result.description: Platform for creators to sell digital goods, memberships and physical products with checkout, payouts and marketing tools.
result.auth_detail: OAuth2 auth-code (register app in Settings > Advanced with Redirect URI; refresh_token issued but access_token doesn't expire until revoked). Single-account personal access token generated via "Generate access token" button. Scopes like view_profile, view_sales, edit_products, etc.
result.access_detail: Any Gumroad account (free to open) can create an application in advanced settings and get OAuth app credentials or a personal access token instantly. No review, plan gate or partnership found. Docs pages are JS-rendered; plan restriction not seen anywhere.
result.api_notes: REST at api.gumroad.com/v2: products (list/get/create/update/delete/enable/disable), variants, offer codes, custom fields, sales (list/refund/ship), subscribers, licenses verify, payouts, user, resource-subscription webhooks. Roughly 40-50 endpoints; core commerce objects covered. Docs at gumroad.com/api are client-rendered so exact endpoint list was confirmed only via secondary sources (Composio toolkit lists 13 tools; community MCP covers products/sales/offer codes). Not a broad 50+ surface, so moderate.

evidence.quote: While we also provide a refresh_token when authenticating a user, we do not expire the access_token until it is revoked manually.
To create an application for general use, you'll need to build a Redirect URI handler to generate access tokens for each of your users.
Instead, use the "Generate access token" button to get your access token.
